PreToolUse.description: Block git push/commit directly to main or master branch. Prompts user to create a feature branch instead.
Scan for secrets before git push using gitleaks (preferred) or grep fallback. Denies the push if secrets are detected in git history or staged changes.

Block Bash commands that would write to control-plane files: ~/.claude/settings.json, hooks/, CLAUDE.md, agents/, orchestrator logs and session.id. Comprehensive write-op detection (redirects, cp, mv, interpreters, etc.).
Remind agents editing agent-toolkit component files to update the component CHANGELOG.md per Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 before finishing. Advisory only — injects additionalContext, never blocks.

Validate that CHANGELOG.md was updated in commits being pushed, and that each modified CHANGELOG.md contains a valid KaC 1.1.0 version header. Note: originally a git pre-push hook; in Codex PreToolUse context, parse stdin for git push commands.

PostToolUse.description: Run integrity-check.sh silently after tool use; emit a WARNING to stderr if toolkit file mismatches are found. Always exits 0, never blocks.
Warn (once per session) when agent-toolkit component files were edited without a paired CHANGELOG.md update. Advisory only — always exits 0.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Inject orchestrator project-brief and file-ownership constraints into each agent prompt. Reads .orchestrator/session.id for session-scoped layout; falls back to flat .orchestrator/ layout. Uncertainty: maps to UserPromptSubmit as closest Codex equivalent to Claude Code's SubagentStart.

Stop.description: Extract handoff JSON from the agent's final message (```handoff fences), validate against canonical schema, and write to .orchestrator/handoffs/<agent_id>.json. Also logs agent_stop event with token/tool usage. Uncertainty: maps to Stop as closest Codex equivalent to Claude Code's SubagentStop.
